description: Custom Log Analytics table contracts for Threat and Exposure Management ingestion.

Rapid7AppSecFindings_CL.description: One Rapid7 web application vulnerability finding on one application, URL, host, or endpoint.

columns.name: AssetId
columns.description: Rapid7 application, asset, or site identifier.

columns.name: AssetType
columns.description: WebApplication, Website, Host, API, or similar.

columns.name: AssetCriticality
columns.description: Critical, High, Medium, Low. Derive from Rapid7 tags if needed.

columns.name: ApplicationName
columns.description: Application display name when different from AssetName.

columns.name: Url
columns.description: Affected URL or application root URL.

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: Source tags used for criticality, ownership, and scope.

columns.name: FindingCategory
columns.description: Vulnerability class such as XSS, SQLi, TLS, or CWE category.

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Informational, or source equivalent.

columns.name: CvssVector
columns.description: CVSS vector string when Rapid7 provides it.

columns.name: Exploitability
columns.description: Exploitability label, exploit maturity, or Rapid7 exploit signal.

columns.name: ExploitAvailable
columns.description: True when an exploit is known or available.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Open, Active, Reopened, Fixed, FalsePositive, AcceptedRisk, or equivalent.

columns.name: FirstSeen
columns.description: First time this finding was observed on this asset.

columns.name: LastSeen
columns.description: Most recent observation time for this finding on this asset.

columns.name: Evidence
columns.description: Proof, request/response metadata, affected parameters, or source details.
